description_en: Queries the prefix route history for an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）前缀路由的历史记录
name: DescribeExpressConnectRouterAllowedPrefixHistory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR) instance
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the network instance that is associated with the ECR.

Specify either the InstanceId or AssociationId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
专线网关加载的实例ID。

InstanceId参数和AssociationId参数必须输入一个
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: A virtual private cloud (VPC) instance.

TR: A transit router (TR) instance
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型。取值：
VPC：虚拟专有网络实例。
TR：转发路由器实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: The system runs a check request. It does not modify any resources.

false (default): The system sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
A client token to ensure that the request is idempotent.

Generate a unique client-side value to ensure that the request is idempotent. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId is unique for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the association between the ECR and the VPC or transit router.

Specify either the InstanceId or AssociationId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
专线网关与专有网络VPC或转发路由器TR的关联的实例ID。

InstanceId参数和AssociationId参数必须输入一个
parameters.name: association_id

AllowedPrefixHistoryList.description_en: The list of historical prefix routes

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the historical route was created
GmtCreate.description_zh: 创建历史路由条目的时间

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates that the request was successful. Other values indicate that the request failed. For more information, see the Error codes section
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message. This message is used to replace the `%s` placeholder in the error message.

For example, if the error message is The value of input parameter %s is not valid. and this parameter returns DtsJobId, it means the specified DtsJobId parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：
True：成功。
False：失败
